title: BaiZe 资产库用户角色（Actor）定义规格 v1
scope: asset-library-only; workflow artifact layer untouched; no approval/readiness/RBAC/audit additions

assetActorSchema.identity: store-level assetId only; no slug id in content

description.description: optional; missing/null normalized to empty string

assetActorSchema.titleRule: title mirrors content.name: create sets title=name; PATCH name updates title
assetActorSchema.uniqueness: within workspace, normalized = name.trim().toLowerCase(); violation on create or PATCH returns 409 name_conflict
assetActorSchema.governance: pure asset-library operation; no approval/readiness/workflow events; audit unchanged (no actorSnapshot recorded, consistent with existing scenario/usecase/function)

referenceShape.semantics: floating reference: store assetId only, resolve to latest revision at display time

validation.location: operator-server create and import branches only; store stays permissive
validation.archivePath: workflow archive → ReusableAsset is permissive: content kept as-is (string actors), no conversion, no validation
validation.importOrder: import batch: first create/remap all kind=actor, then create scenario/usecase; validation view = batch-created + existing

name_conflict.note: create or PATCH name uniqueness violation

asset_referenced.note: delete guard; scans same-workspace scenario/usecase current revisions only (floating refs resolve to latest)

patch.semantics: append new revision (revisionNo increments, content digest recomputed); merged content = { name, description }; title follows name; returns 200 { revisionId, revisionNo }
errors: 404 unknown_asset for non-actor kind or missing asset
patch.concurrency: no optimistic lock; last write wins (consistent with existing create)

delete.guard: scan same-workspace scenario/usecase current-revision contents for references to this actor assetId
delete.referenced: 409 asset_referenced with refs list (referencing assets only, no revisions)

export.referencedContent: actors/actor references replaced with embedded snapshot { assetId, name, description } (current definition at export time)

import.remap: for each embedded snapshot: find actor by name (trim+case-insensitive) in target workspace → reuse its assetId; not found → create actor from name+description (source=import) and use new assetId; rewrite referencing content assetIds
import.snapshotIs: match key + creation seed only; never an overwrite source
import.order: batch-internal: all kind=actor first, then referencing scenario/usecase
import.validation: R02 rules apply after remap (batch + existing view)

ui.tabs: asset library page KINDS adds actor → 「参与者库」tab

createForm.actor: structured two-field form: name (required) / description (optional) → content { name, description }

ui.hints: when creating/editing scenario or usecase, readonly hint under form: available actors from listAssets(kind=actor) as id+name list; paste assetId
ui.errors: invalid_actor_ref → per-path red lines (e.g. 「actors[1]: 参与者 12 不存在」)

threeStates.state: reference shape but assetId missing from resolvedActors (should not occur)

detailRendering.json: full content JSON remains in existing <pre> block

ui.emptyStates: existing empty-state pattern kept; actor tab adds 「请先新建参与者，再在场景/用例中引用它」
ui.deleteConflict: 409 asset_referenced → 「该参与者被以下资产引用,无法删除」 + referencing asset titles (translate assetIds to titles)

displayResolution.location: backend enrich on GET /api/assets/:id; content itself untouched; separate resolvedActors field; legacy string shape returned as-is
displayResolution.rationale: front-end makes no second fetch; server remains the single validation/enrichment authority

variables.expect: new revision; title synced; merged content {name,desc}
400 invalid_actor_ref when any referenced actor missing
invalidRefs lists all invalid references, not first only
actors created before referencing scenario/usecase in same import
reuse existing assetId; no definition overwrite
create actor with source=import; referencing content rewritten
permissive: no conversion, no validation, content as-is

reviewChecklist: 契约完整：R01–R04 决议逐项落入本规格
一致性：与既有 store/server/web 类型、CHECK 约束、A08 ReusableAsset 模型无冲突
无兼容层：无新旧引用形状并存的双写/适配
无越界：未动 artifact-content；未加 RBAC/审批/审计
releaseGate: 用户对《资产库用户角色定义规格》（评审文档）人工评审通过 = 本图终点；实现切面化落地走 BaiZe 既有实现流程
